run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the index of zero to flip for longest continuous ones sequence
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple binary array inputs to verify correct zero flip index
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks prev_zero and prev_prev_zero to find optimal flip index
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns the index to flip from zero to one for longest ones sequence
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases like all ones or all zeros arrays
